newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daikyo share down after poor earnings announcement.
newsitem.headline: Daikyo share down after poor earnings announcement.

text.p: Shares of Daikyo Inc fell on Friday afternoon on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, following the company's announcement that its profits fell sharply in the year to March 31, 1997, and that it expected the downward trend to continue through the current business year.
By 0542 GMT, Daikyo shares were 437 yen, down 13 yen.

The condominium builder said earlier on Friday that its parent net profit in 1996/97 fell year-on-year 92.4 percent and that it had cut its total dividend for 1996/97 to 7.50 yen in 1996/97, down 2.50 yen from a year ago.
It said its parent current profit in 1997/98 would fall a year-on-year 22.5 percent although its 1997/98 net profit would rise from a year ago.
Daikyo said it would further cut its total dividend to five yen in 1997/98.
